q1_issues.issue: `(PartOf sk_pool_1 sk_pool_group_1)` asserts that "the second pool from the north" is one of the five blooming pools, a link the text never states, and it makes the blooming distribution rule (statement 44) derive that this pool is blooming.
`(Ordinal sk_pool_1 2 north)` puts a direction constant in the scale slot, which the instruction set defines as an associated event class or an '-est' dimension.

q2_gaps: spatially-anchored ordinal ("the second pool from the north") — `Ordinal`'s scale slot is defined only for an associated event or an '-est' dimension, not a direction or reference point the ranking counts from

a proper name whose internal kind word is plural ("the Salt-bloom Tide-pools") — the name-plus-type-atom rule is written for a singular kind word, leaving `Member` vs `GroupOf` undetermined for a named plurality
a day-of-year date with no month ("day 33 of Year 1") — the `Day <n>` term is specified as a calendar day inside a month
notes: The ∀∃ assignment rule over `(PartOf $x sk_party_1)` with the dependent Skolem pool, the descriptive-modifier distribution rule for "blooming", and the differential `copper_bucket` (noun modifier, no genus) vs `wooden_scraper` (adjective modifier, genus emitted) handling all match the instruction set. Coraline Ash is correctly kept a `CoAgent` rather than asserted a party member.
